hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f || exit 0; case "$f" in *goodreads_mcp/*.py) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; command -v pytest >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; if ! out=$(pytest -q 2>&1); then printf '%s' "$out" | tail -20 | jq -Rs '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:("Offline tests failed after this edit:\n" + .)}}'; fi; }
